info.title: karafin
info.author: doomtrain14
info.description: Karafin is a Jellyfin client switch
info.details: Karafin is a Jellyfin client for the Nintendo Switch, written in C++20. It runs as a homebrew .nro on Atmosphère and is built with current libnx for firmware 22.\n\nAI use: AI-assisted. AI also used for: icon/banner art.

changelog:
Servers & Accounts: Discover LAN servers or connect via address, save multiple server/user profiles, and sign in with a password or Quick Connect.

Browsing & Library: Navigate a personalized home screen (Continue Watching, Next Up, Recently Added), filter/sort library grids with A–Z jump, search, manage favorites/watch status, and view detailed media pages with cast and track pickers.

Playback & Controls: Hardware-accelerated direct play (H.264, HEVC, VP8/9, MPEG-2/VC-1, plus software AV1 up to 1080p) with HLS transcoding fallback and multi-format audio downmixing. Includes cross-device resume, Trickplay seeking, intro/recap/credits skipping, autoplay, chapters, speed/zoom controls, playback info overlay, and touch gestures for brightness/volume.

Subtitles: Supports embedded and external tracks (SRT, ASS/SSA, VTT, PGS, DVD) with automatic language/mode selection, appearance/timing customization, and live in-player subtitle downloads via server plugins.

Offline Downloads: Download movies, episodes, seasons, or full series with original files, artwork, and subtitles. Features crash-safe pause/resume (even across restarts or power cuts), FAT32 >4 GB file support, free-space checks, and automatic watch-progress syncing upon reconnection.
